entries.heading: For an additional amount for the cost of direct loans and
ancestors: DIVISION B—AGRICULTURE, RURAL DEVELOPMENT, FOOD AND DRUG ADMINISTRATION, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2019
entries.text:
Sec. 763.  For an additional amount for the cost of direct loans and 
grants made under the ``Rural Water and Waste Disposal Program 
Account'', $75,000,000, to remain available until expended.
